title: Radio
overview: One exclusive choice from a short visible set.
apply_when: Two to about five options; the answer is one of them.
not_when: Many options (select), many-of (checkbox), or immediate on/off (switch).

vs.why: more than one may be true

role.overview: One exclusive choice from a short visible set.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Label sits with the radio; radios stay left of labels where that is the house.
composition.not_when: A radio with no visible label.

composition.overview: Choosing an option reveals a related field.
composition.apply_when: A follow-up that only applies to that answer.
composition.not_when: Revealing content with no name change on the radio.

composition.overview: An Or (or similar) splits the set.
composition.apply_when: None of the above / other as a last exclusive option.
composition.not_when: A divider that is itself a radio.

state.overview: At rest, available, not selected or selected as stored.
state.not_when: The group is disabled or submitting.

state.overview: Pointer is over the control — extra cue, not the only cue.
state.apply_when: A mouse or trackpad can reach the control.
state.not_when: Hover is the only selected cue.

state.overview: Keyboard or AT is on this option. Must stay visible.
state.apply_when: Tab, arrow keys, or restoring focus after an error.
state.not_when: Focus outline removed with no replacement.

state.overview: This option is not available. Must stay perceivable.
state.apply_when: An option that must not be chosen on this view.
The stored or in-progress value includes this option.
state.not_when: A visual tick with no accessible state.

accessibility.overview: The option (and the group) have names AT can speak.
accessibility.apply_when: Any choice control, especially a group with no legend.
accessibility.not_when: The only name is placeholder copy next to an unlabeled box.

accessibility.apply_when: Keyboard or AT focus is on an option.

accessibility.overview: Unavailable stays in the tab order and explains why.
accessibility.apply_when: An option that must not run.
accessibility.not_when: HTML disabled that drops the option from the keyboard flow.

accessibility.overview: The hit area includes the label, not only the box.
accessibility.not_when: A 16px box with a disconnected label.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on the group or the checked option in a logical order.
keyboard.not_when: Each option is a separate tab stop when arrows should move inside the group.

keyboard.overview: Arrow keys move between options in the group.
keyboard.apply_when: Radios, a listbox, or a segmented set.
keyboard.not_when: Arrows scroll the page because the group never took focus.

keyboard.overview: Space toggles or selects the focused option.
keyboard.not_when: Space scrolls the page instead of activating.

keyboard.overview: Enter selects the focused option when that is the house pattern.
keyboard.apply_when: A listbox or menu of choices.
keyboard.not_when: Enter submits the whole form instead of picking.
